lines.trans: Before the movers cleared the house, I saved this parcel from the attic.
Open the white paper... no! Grandfather carved wooden locomotive!
Look underneath the wheels: your name and mine are still written there in pencil.
I thought it got lost during the house sale! Why did you save it for me?
